# MUSEO NIVOLA GETS A NEW LOOK

Nov 2, 2026

![](https://museonivola.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Costantino-Nivola.png "Costantino Nivola")

You have until October 25 to visit the permanent collection dedicated to Nivola, before some of the works leave for Milan for the major exhibition Costantino Nivola. Scolpire il vento, curated by Cecilia Alemani, at the Triennale.

From October 25 to November 8, you will be able to visit the exhibition Nivola, Colombo and the Space Around Them.

But the Museum never stops: on Saturday, November 28, we will reopen to the public with a new exhibition layout dedicated to Nivola, designed to guide visitors through an entirely new thematic journey, alongside two temporary exhibitions included in the Nivola. vis-à-vis programme.
